content:
According to Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman, Apple is preparing to launch its Home product line and will make significant changes to its physical retail stores. Apple is expected to announce updated versions of the HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K as early as this fall, and the related changes seem to hint that a third, more important product will be unveiled at the same time.

Apple has accumulated a large number of unreleased Home products, mainly because the Siri revamp project has been delayed time and again. With the Siri redesign finally completed, you can expect some products to finally see the light of day after years without updates.

However, earlier reports had indicated that Apple would first launch updated versions of the HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K, while the company's first smart home hub (i.e., a HomePod or HomePad with a built-in screen) might not arrive until later.

However, based on the current retail store preparations, this smart home hub may be launched at the same time as the updated Apple TV and HomePod mini. The above content comes from the Power On newsletter.

Of course, the final answer will have to wait until Apple's September launch event to be confirmed. However, according to today's report, Apple's brand-new smart home hub is very likely to debut alongside the new Apple TV 4K supporting Siri AI and the HomePod mini.

Quick overview

In summary, Apple's smart home hub is widely rumored to feature a 7-inch square display and will come in two versions: one with a built-in speaker, and another with a magnet on the back for wall mounting. This product will run a brand-new operating system with a home screen that supports widgets. In addition to supporting FaceTime video calls, it will also serve as the central hub for all smart home accessories and Siri, and will feature a built-in A18 chip.

Another rumor about the Home product line is that the next-generation Apple TV 4K may come with an updated Siri Remote, though the specific changes remain unclear for now.

Are you interested in the new Home products? Which one are you most looking forward to? Feel free to share with us in the comment section.
